prompt: Implement a class `BoundedQueue` with `BoundedQueue(capacity: int)`, `enqueue(item) -> bool` (returns False if full, else adds and returns True), `dequeue() -> item or None` (returns None if empty, else removes and returns the oldest item, FIFO), and `size() -> int`.
test_suite:
import unittest

class Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fifo_order(self):
        q = BoundedQueue(5)
        q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2); q.enqueue(3)
        self.assertEqual(q.dequeue(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(q.dequeue(), 2)
    def test_full_queue_rejects(self):
        q = BoundedQueue(2)
        q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2)
        self.assertFalse(q.enqueue(3))
    def test_empty_dequeue(self):
        q = BoundedQueue(2)
        self.assertIsNone(q.dequeue())
    def test_size_tracks_correctly(self):
        q = BoundedQueue(5)
        q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2)
        q.dequeue()
        self.assertEqual(q.size(), 1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
